title: JSON Patch
description: Apply partial updates to JSON documents using RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations.

data.text: `Microsoft.AspNetCore.JsonPatch` implements RFC 6902 JSON Patch. It allows clients to send a list of patch operations to partially update a resource, which is ideal for PATCH endpoints in REST APIs.
Use `JsonPatchDocument<T>` to define operations like `replace`, `add`, `remove`, and `test`. Apply the patch to the target object.

data.title: PATCH Endpoint
data.content: Handle a PATCH request in a minimal API.

data.text: JSON Patch supports several operations defined by RFC 6902. The most common are `replace` and `add`.

terms.definition: A list of operations to apply to an object of type T.
Executes the patch operations against the target object.
The IETF standard that defines JSON Patch operations.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Always validate the patch document before applying it. The JsonPatchDocument can reject invalid paths with a JsonPatchException.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Supports replace, add, remove, copy, move, and test
data.takeaway: JSON Patch lets clients modify only the fields they need, reducing bandwidth and conflict risk.
